start_otlp_collector: start a LightweightOtlpCollector on a gRPC port to receive OTLP trace data for test assertions
check_span_exists: check if a named span exists in the in-memory OTLP collector using has_span
get_collected_spans: get all collected Span objects from the OTLP collector for test verification
verify_all_spans: verify that all expected span names were captured by the OTLP collector using has_all_spans
stop_otlp_collector: stop the running LightweightOtlpCollector and clean up the gRPC or HTTP server
